name: Santa Clara County, CA
findings: Santa Clara County has 7,172 nonprofit organizations. 2,579 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2,024 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Santa Clara County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list public events
observations.text: 25 health care organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 54 would.

confidence.text: Based on 54 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for civic or political action
observations.text: 24 political organizations here list civic or political action, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do political organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 894 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 894 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
